objectives.description: Build harness with absolute-path cd + toplevel assertion safety guard
Case B --branch mode standing regression guard - 4 assertions
Case F clean tree no-op all 3 modes - 9 assertions
Case G marker contract guard-hook parse - 3 assertions
Cleanup: delete scratch repo, verify parent repo unaffected (no wip-snapshot branches, no stash entries)

deviations.description: Case C asserts git status --porcelain byte-identical to captured pre-run value
deviations.reason: The script always writes new output artifacts (patch, marker, and in --no-revert mode the untracked-backup dir) as new untracked files, which necessarily changes git status --porcelain output in every mode, not just --no-revert. This is inherent to the script's design (it must report where it wrote things) and was already observed in the Phase 2 functional test of default mode. The harness instead asserts the two properties that actually matter: the pre-existing tracked modification is byte-unchanged and the pre-existing untracked file still exists at its original path.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — asserted tracked-content-unchanged + untracked-file-presence instead of literal porcelain byte-equality; see Phase 6 Case C note)*
